title: What REALLY Happens When Neuralink Connects to Your Brain

scenes.name: Robotic Thread Insertion
scenes.narration: You might think a brain chip is plugged directly into your skull like a USB cable. But the real process is vastly more delicate.

scenes.name: Microscopic Thread Navigation
scenes.narration: A robotic needle inserts sixty-four ultra-thin polymer threads into your motor cortex, actively dodging blood vessels to prevent bleeding.

scenes.name: Action Potential Voltage Reading
scenes.narration: Over one thousand microscopic electrodes detect tiny microvolt spikes as your neurons fire, converting raw thought into digital binary code.

scenes.name: Glial Cellular Encapsulation
scenes.narration: Your immune cells swarm the threads and form a thin protective scar, but the flexible polymer moves naturally with your brain's blood pulse.

scenes.name: Mind-Controlled Bionic Interface
scenes.narration: Onboard AI filters the signals in real time, allowing paralyzed patients to move computer cursors or robotic limbs with pure thought.
